_note: DRAFT written by the assistant at a 5th-grade reading level. Coach: edit freely. 'watch' is the play and defense the Watch it button runs. Only pairings where the app's own read agrees are used.

cards.title: Smash
cards.tagline: A short route under a deep route. The defender has to pick one.
how: Two receivers on the same side.
One runs short (a comeback). One runs deep (a corner).
The defender in between cannot cover both.
cards.look: B runs the corner. A turns back on the comeback. Who does the callout say is open?

cards.title: Mesh
cards.tagline: Two receivers cross at different depths and tangle up the defenders.
how: The two slot receivers run past each other.
Man defenders chasing them bump into each other.
That bump gives your receiver room to catch.
cards.look: Watch B and Y cross in the middle. See the defenders follow them?

cards.title: Flood
cards.tagline: Three receivers on one side at three depths: deep, middle and short.
how: Three receivers run to the same side.
One goes deep, one in the middle, one short.
One defender cannot cover three levels.
cards.look: Z goes deep, Y runs the out, and C is short. Who is open?

cards.title: Four Verticals
cards.tagline: Everyone runs deep. Defenders run out of room.
how: Every receiver runs straight down the field.
Cover 3 only has three deep defenders.
With more runners than defenders, someone gets open.
cards.look: Count the runners. Count the deep defenders. Who is left alone?

cards.title: Quick Slants
cards.tagline: Fast routes. Catch it and go before the defense can react.
how: Every receiver cuts inside right away.
The ball comes out fast.
Great when defenders are playing deep and giving space.
cards.look: The ball is out quickly. Who finds the open space?

cards.title: Bunch Cross
cards.tagline: Three receivers start close together, then cross.
how: Starting close together makes the defenders crowd up.
The receivers cross in different directions.
Man defenders cannot stay with them.
cards.look: Watch the bunch cross. The center runs a dig behind them.

cards.title: Motion Tell
cards.tagline: Motion shows you if the defense is man or zone.
how: Send one receiver in motion.
If a defender runs with him, it is man.
If nobody follows, it is zone.
cards.look: Y crosses the field. Who goes with him? Then try it against Cover 3.

cards.title: Count the Safeties
cards.tagline: Before the snap, count how many safeties are deep.
how: One safety deep in the middle: Cover 3 or Man.
Two safeties deep, splitting the field: Cover 2.
Then use motion to tell Cover 3 from Man.
cards.look: Two safeties split the deep field. Now switch to Cover 3 and compare.
